conflictDelta.description: Unused. Kept so older saved configs still load. Mixed is no longer based on clip-level score ties.

analyzeChunkSeconds.description: Max seconds of 16 kHz mono held per YAMNet call when stitching long files. Not a skip-inference gate.

ingestMode.description: move relocates dropped files into the library. copy leaves the original in place and tags only the library file.

playbackVolume.description: Chromium output level for the temp 16-bit preview. Does not alter library files.

autoPlayOnSelect.description: Start playback when a single file is selected.

playbackPitch.description: Preview playbackRate as a percent (100 = original). Chromium only; library files stay unchanged.

playbackPreservePitch.description: When true, Chromium time-stretches the preview and keeps the original pitch. When false, playbackRate is varispeed (pitch and tempo together).
